title: Unlimited Student Annual: Student Status Verification Terms
content:
**Student programme terms — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited**

1. Unlimited Student Annual is the only Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan that requires verified student status. To hold it, a customer's status must be verified by SheerID as enrolled at an accredited US college or university.
2. A student verification lasts 12 calendar months.
3. Where the verification lapses, the member has 14 calendar days after the lapse to re-verify before the plan moves at renewal.
4. A student membership that is not re-verified renews into Unlimited Standard Annual.

| Plan | Verified student status required | Verified by | Verification lasts | Re-verification grace after a lapse | Plan it renews into when not re-verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Student Annual | Yes | SheerID | 12 calendar months | 14 calendar days | Unlimited Standard Annual |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | No | Not applicable | 0 (not a student plan) | 0 (not a student plan) | Not applicable |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | No | Not applicable | 0 (not a student plan) | 0 (not a student plan) | Not applicable |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | No | Not applicable | 0 (not a student plan) | 0 (not a student plan) | Not applicable |
| Unlimited Express Annual | No | Not applicable | 0 (not a student plan) | 0 (not a student plan) | Not applicable |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | No | Not applicable | 0 (not a student plan) | 0 (not a student plan) | Not applicable |

The membership record of a student plan shows the last day of the student verification; on every other plan that date is empty.

Hypothetical illustration: a verification completed on 1 September is good for 12 calendar months; a lapse is followed by a grace of 14 calendar days in which the member may re-verify.
